name: @activecampaign/postmark-mcp
description: Official Postmark MCP server for sending emails via Claude and AI assistants

scripts.presmoke:
node --input-type=module --eval "import{existsSync}from'fs';if(!existsSync('./smoke-test.mjs')){console.error('
smoke-test.mjs not found.
Copy the example file and add your verified sender address:

  cp smoke-test.example.mjs smoke-test.mjs

Then edit smoke-test.mjs and set FROM_EMAIL to a verified Postmark sender.
');process.exit(1)}"
